annotations.text:
Direction: civic editorial, like a public notice.
Warm paper, navy ink, civic blue, plus a highlighter yellow that pulls the one line that matters out of a 100+ page agenda.
Type: Newsreader (headlines) · Atkinson Hyperlegible (body, built for legibility) · IBM Plex Mono (dates and labels).
Urgency always pairs color with an icon and words, never color alone. Meeting content is sample data.
Alt A and Alt B (below the modal) are rough sketches of two other directions: a dense ledger and a bold front-page bulletin. Pick one if you prefer it and I'll take it hi-fi.
